newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower,but sentiment stays bullish.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower,but sentiment stays bullish.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended lower on Thursday, bruised by profit-taking after three days of gains, brokers said. They added however that certain shares posted healthy gains and market sentiment continued to be fairly bullish.
The 225-share Nikkei average shed 123.41 points or 0.60 percent to finish at 20,488.15. Its June futures slipped 80 yen to finish at 20,470.
"The indices were weak, but some high-tech, real estate and major issues defied the trend," said Harushige Kobayashi, Yamaichi Securities deputy general manager.
